llms.body:
# Lovable

> Lovable is an AI-powered platform for building web and mobile apps, websites, and internal tools from natural-language prompts.

This file lists the main hubs of lovable.dev for AI assistants and answer engines. Full product documentation lives at https://docs.lovable.dev/llms.txt.

## Product

- [Pricing](https://lovable.dev/pricing): Plans, credits, and pricing for individuals, teams, and enterprises.
- [Enterprise](https://lovable.dev/enterprise-landing): Lovable for enterprise — security, governance, and scale.
- [Security](https://lovable.dev/security): Lovable's security posture, compliance, and data handling.
- [Lovable Cloud](https://lovable.dev/cloud): Built-in backend, database, and hosting for Lovable apps.
- [Internal tools](https://lovable.dev/tools): Build internal tools and dashboards with Lovable.
- [Prototyping](https://lovable.dev/prototypes): Turn ideas into interactive prototypes.
- [Shopify](https://lovable.dev/shopify): Build Shopify storefronts and apps with Lovable.
- [Supabase integration](https://lovable.dev/supabase-integration): Connect Lovable apps to a Supabase backend.
- [SEO & AEO](https://lovable.dev/seo-aeo): Search- and answer-engine optimization for Lovable sites.
- [Growth tools](https://lovable.dev/grow): A plan for your first users, then search, community posts, and ads from the Lovable chat.
- [Download apps](https://lovable.dev/download): Desktop and mobile Lovable apps.

## Documentation

- [Documentation (llms.txt)](https://docs.lovable.dev/llms.txt): Curated index of Lovable product documentation for LLMs.
- [Documentation (llms-full.txt)](https://docs.lovable.dev/llms-full.txt): Full-text Lovable documentation for LLMs.
- [Lovable MCP server](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/lovable-mcp-server): Connect AI tools to Lovable to create and manage projects.
- [Lovable MCP endpoint](https://mcp.lovable.dev): Remote MCP endpoint for programmatic access to Lovable.

## Guides

- [Guides](https://lovable.dev/guides): Step-by-step guides and tutorials for building with Lovable.
- [App alternatives](https://lovable.dev/guides/category/app-alternatives): App alternatives guides.
- [App comparisons](https://lovable.dev/guides/category/app-comparisons): App comparisons guides.
- [App inspiration](https://lovable.dev/guides/category/app-inspiration): App inspiration guides.
- [App teardowns](https://lovable.dev/guides/category/app-teardowns): App teardowns guides.
- [Best apps tools](https://lovable.dev/guides/category/best-apps-tools): Best apps tools guides.
- [Business](https://lovable.dev/guides/category/business): Business guides.
- [Business app ideas](https://lovable.dev/guides/category/business-app-ideas): Business app ideas guides.
- [Comparisons](https://lovable.dev/guides/category/comparisons): Comparisons guides.
- [Competitive comparisons](https://lovable.dev/guides/category/competitive-comparisons): Competitive comparisons guides.
- [How to](https://lovable.dev/guides/category/how-to): How to guides.
- [Product comparisons](https://lovable.dev/guides/category/product-comparisons): Product comparisons guides.
- [Resources for solopreneur](https://lovable.dev/guides/category/resources-for-solopreneur): Resources for solopreneur guides.
- [Use case pages](https://lovable.dev/guides/category/use-case-pages): Use case pages guides.
- [Website definitions explainers](https://lovable.dev/guides/category/website-definitions-explainers): Website definitions explainers guides.
- [Website inspiration](https://lovable.dev/guides/category/website-inspiration): Website inspiration guides.

## Use cases

- [Solutions & use cases](https://lovable.dev/solutions): Use cases and solutions for building apps, websites, and products.

## Templates

- [Templates](https://lovable.dev/templates): Browse starter templates by category.
- [Apps](https://lovable.dev/templates/apps): Apps templates.
- [Websites](https://lovable.dev/templates/websites): Websites templates.

## Blog

- [Blog](https://lovable.dev/blog): Articles, product news, and insights from the Lovable team.

## Optional

- [Partner directory](https://lovable-partner-directory.lovable.app/): Hire a vetted Lovable partner or agency.
- [Partners](https://lovable.dev/partners): Partner and affiliate programs.
- [Careers](https://lovable.dev/careers): Open roles at Lovable.
- [Support](https://lovable.dev/support): Help center and support resources.
- [Videos](https://lovable.dev/videos): Video tutorials and walkthroughs.
- [Reviews](https://lovable.dev/reviews): What customers say about Lovable.
- [Brand](https://lovable.dev/brand): Brand guidelines and assets.
- [Connectors](https://lovable.dev/connect): Chat connectors and integrations available in Lovable.
